Posts.RecruitPostName: 资深 UI/UX 设计师（暗黑幻想 ARPG) Senior UI/UX Designer (Dark Fantasy ARPG)
Posts.Responsibility:
团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。

想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
复杂系统UX设计：负责核心系统的交互逻辑设计（如：商店、交易、赛季玩法等），需要将复杂的数值和机制转化为直观、易懂的操作流程。
暗黑美学UI视觉： 设计符合“暗黑奇幻”世界观的高品质界面，熟练运用金属、石材、羊皮纸、血液、玻璃等材质表现，打造具有厚重感和历史感的拟物化UI。
跨平台体验（PC & Console）： 针对键鼠和手柄两种操作模式进行差异化设计，确保复杂的UI在手柄操作下依然顺滑。
动效与反馈： 设计UI的动态效果（如：技能冷却的流光、升级时的金属撞击感、血球的液体流动），增强操作的打击感和反馈。
跨职能协作：与策划、程序、美术紧密配合，确保设计方案在技术可行性与艺术风格上的统一，推动设计落地并跟进迭代。
Complex System UX Design: Design interaction logic for core systems (e.g., Store, Trading, Season Mechanics), transforming complex numerical values and mechanisms into intuitive, easy-to-understand operational workflows.
Dark Aesthetic UI Visuals: Create high-quality interfaces aligned with the "dark fantasy" worldview, proficiently using materials like metal, stone, parchment, blood, and glass to craft skeuomorphic UIs with a sense of heaviness and historical depth.
Cross-Platform Experience (PC & Console): Conduct differentiated design for keyboard-mouse and controller operation modes, ensuring smooth navigation of complex UIs even with controller input.
Motion Effects & Feedback: Design dynamic UI effects (e.g., flowing light for skill cooldowns, metallic impact sensations during level-ups, liquid flow in health orbs) to enhance the sense of impact and feedback in operations.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Closely collaborate with planners, programmers, and artists to ensure design proposals align with technical feasibility and artistic style; drive design implementation and follow up on iterations.

岗位要求
经验：3-5年以上游戏UI/UX设计经验，至少参与过一款中重度游戏（MMO、ARPG、SLG）的完整开发。
精通Figma/Photoshop/Illustrator等设计工具，熟练输出交互原型、设计规范及标注文档。
手柄适配经验：有主机游戏UI开发经验，深谙手柄交互逻辑。
具备良好的逻辑思维能力和解决问题的能力，责任心强，善于沟通。
参与过PoE like的ARPG的UI/UX设计或者活跃于游戏玩家社区，能从玩家视角预判体验痛点。
能用英语交流者优先。
Experience: 3–5+ years of game UI/UX design experience, with participation in the full development cycle of at least one mid-to-heavyweight game (MMO, ARPG, SLG).
Tools Proficiency: Mastery of design tools such as Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator; skilled in delivering interactive prototypes, design specifications, and annotation documents.
Controller Adaptation Experience: Experience in console game UI development and deep understanding of controller interaction logic.
Soft Skills: Strong logical thinking and problem-solving abilities; highly responsible and excellent in communication.
Experience in UI/UX design for PoE-like ARPGs, or active engagement in gaming communities with the ability to anticipate user experience pain points from a player’s perspective.
English proficiency for communication is preferred.

What the Role Entails
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Game Operation Intern to support the publishing and promotional operations of Delta Force across PC, mobile, and console platforms in the Japanese market. This role is ideal for individuals who are passionate about gaming—especially FPS titles—and thrive in dynamic, cross-cultural environments.
As a member of the game operations and promotion team, you will be responsible for executing and coordinating a wide range of activities including PR, esports, influencer collaborations, events, and community engagement. You will also be expected to analyze market trends and player feedback to help refine and optimize publishing strategies.『Delta Force』の日本向けパブリッシングチームの一員として、ゲームに関連するパブリッシングおよびプロモーションの進行、効果測定、施策実行まで幅広い業務。
広告の企画立案・実行、SNSを活用したコミュニティキャンペーンのプランニング、広告クリエイティブの企画/制作/運用の進行、プロモーション施策の効果分析など。
イベントやeスポーツ大会開催時の準備や進行、演出内容や当日のWeb配信などイベントをより盛り上げていただく施策などゲームからの派生コンテンツの作成/運用。
マーケット・ユーザー・競合に関する調査・分析。
高い責任感と実行力をもって、社内外とのリソースの調整・連携。
パブリッシング関連資料の翻訳業務。
Support and execute publishing-related tasks for Delta Force across three platforms (PC, mobile, console) in the Japanese market.
Carry out, track, and summarize promotional activities related to publishing, including PR, esports, KOLs, events, community engagement, and public opinion monitoring.
Conduct research and analysis on the Japanese market, users, and competitors for FPS (First-Person Shooter) games, monitor market sentiment, and provide valuable feedback and suggestions.
Demonstrate strong execution and a high sense of responsibility by coordinating project resources across different teams.
Communicate with HQ and Japanese vendors regarding publishing-related matters (both spoken and written in business-level language).
Translate game and publishing-related documents and materials.

細かいタスク管理、多文化環境での業務や海外チームとの連携に適応できる方。
ゲームが好きで、ゲーム業界やFPSゲームユーザー動向への理解を持ち、ゲーム業界の専門用語を熟知していること。ゲームマーケティングの経験がある方を優先。
高い文書作成能力、コミュニケーション能力、論理思考能力、問題解決能力、積極的な実行力と推進力、高い責任感とチームワーク精神を有すること。
日本での生活経験やゲーム業界での勤務経験がある方を優先
言語スキル：日本語と中国語はビジネスレベル以上を有する方を優先。
Highly detail-oriented, strong execution skills, clear logic, and strong organizational ability.
Passionate about gaming, with a good understanding of the gaming industry and FPS game ecosystem; familiarity with gaming industry terminology. Experience in game marketing is a plus.
Strong documentation and writing skills, excellent communication and coordination abilities, solid logical thinking, problem-solving skills, proactive execution and initiative, strong sense of responsibility, and team spirit.
Experience living in Japan or working in the gaming industry is a plus.

团队介绍
Level Infinite 是腾讯旗下国际游戏业务品牌，致力为全球玩家带来充满乐趣、原汁原味的游戏体验，让玩家随时随地进入游戏世界；并通过打造包容、互通、便捷的玩家社区，促进分享交流。
Level Infinite为合作工作室提供一系列支持及服务，助力其释放产品潜能。
Level Infinite发行产品包括《PUBG MOBILE》、《Goddess of Victory: NIKKE 》《Honor of King》等热门游戏，并与合作工作室联手推出了来自Fatshark的《战锤40K：暗潮》、Funcom的《沙丘：觉醒》、Inflexion Studios的《夜莺》在内多款产品。
想进一步了解Level Infinite，请访问www.levelinfinite.com，并在Twitter、Facebook、Instagram和Youtube上关注我们的官方账号。

岗位职责
1、AI 工作流体系建设： 深度研究并实操 Stable Diffusion, Midjourney, ComfyUI, Flux 等前沿 AIGC 工具。针对IAA、休闲类游戏的业务场景，搭建并输出标准化的 AI 绘画、视频生成、3D 辅助及试玩广告工作流（Workflow），实现生产力的标准化与规模化。
2、高品质创意产出： 运用 AI 工具辅助完成高完成度的平面视觉、动态视频或 3D 辅助素材。确保最终产出符合全球化市场的“商业级”审美。
3、效能工具开发与沉淀： 作为创意与技术的桥梁，深度参与公司内部 AI 协作平台的定义与迭代；沉淀团队专属的 AI 风格模型库、工作流模板及 Agent 资源。
4、项目管理与创意生产： 负责跨部门（投放、设计、研发）创意项目的全周期管理。精准把控项目创意落地，平衡“创意脑洞”与“技术实现边界”，确保素材高质量准时交付。
5、前沿趋势与技术布道： 持续追踪 AIGC 领域，的最前沿动态。定期组织内部分享，将复杂的 AI 技术转化为团队可落地的实战教程，提升全员 AI 素养。

岗位要求
1、专业背景： 本科及以上学历，设计、美术或计算机相关专业优先。具备深厚的美术功底，对光影、构图、色彩有极强的敏锐度。
2、行业洞察： 热爱游戏，对全球游戏素材趋势有深入理解（尤其是休闲、IAA品类），能通过 AI 手段解决特定风格化或写实化的业务痛点。
3、AI 专家级实操： 精通 ComfyUI 节点式逻辑、模型微调、插件调用及 Agent 自动化流程搭建。有实际解决复杂风格化需求、提升生产效率的案例者优先。
4、沟通与方法论： 优秀的表达能力，能撰写清晰的 AI 使用手册或技术方案。具备“授人以渔”的精神，能带动团队完成从传统工作流向 AI 工作流的转型。

About the Hiring Team
The Overseas Procurement Department is an essential component of Tencent's global operations, managing procurement processes on an international scale. This dedicated team is crucial in acquiring essential resources and ensuring the efficient functioning of Tencent's global initiatives by sourcing and securing necessary materials and services. With a focus on optimization and resource management, the department significantly contributes to the overall success of Tencent's international endeavors.

What the Role Entails
About Tencent
Tencent is a world-leading internet and technology company that develops innovative products and services to improve the quality of life of people around the world. Founded in 1998 with its headquarters in Shenzhen China, our guiding principle is to use technology for good.
We are not only a major video game publisher in the world, we also produce other high-quality digital content, enriching interactive entertainment experiences for people around the globe. We offer a range of services such as cloud computing, advertising, FinTech, and other enterprise services to support our client's digital transformation and business growth.
About Overseas Procurement Team
The Tencent Overseas Procurement Team is responsible for leading and managing global procurement operations and strategic sourcing across our international regions. Through active sourcing of suppliers and agencies, negotiation and relationship management, the candidate will play an important role in driving operational excellence for the support of Tencent’s global business objectives.Responsible for the procurement operation and commercial management of AI GPU/ Cloud service/AI model projects, including progress management, demand management, commercial negotiations, price management, contract management, and issue management during execution.
According to the business development strategy, formulate procurement strategies and implementation; responsible for the development, management, performance evaluation, and improvement of suppliers.
Collect and analyze market trends, market changes, and provide a basis for procurement decisions.
Possess the ability to streamline and diagnose processes and promote cross-team problem-solving.

Who We Look For
Aligns with Tencent's corporate culture, displays integrity and responsibility, excels in cross-team collaboration, and possesses strong interpersonal communication skills.
Bachelor's degree or higher, with 5+ years of experience in procurement business or supply chain management for IDC/Server/AI Procurement etc. Prefer 2+ years of procurement experience working locally.
Experience in independently managing procurement projects, profound knowledge in the procurement field; outstanding business negotiation skills, passionate, resilient, meticulous in work, responsible, and high stress tolerance.
Strong organizational management skills, logical thinking abilities, problem-solving capabilities, and document editing skills.
Demonstrates good learning and communication skills, problem analysis and resolution abilities, and can work under pressure.
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Proficiency in Chinese (Mandarin) is preferred due to the need to collaborate closely with stakeholders based in headquarters and across regional teams.
